dedupe_keys.name: somalia health facilities who about 520 hospitals health centres and other facilities with region district type and coordinates

description: This data set lists the health facilities of Somalia with their locations, as compiled by the World Health Organization for humanitarian planning. It is published by WHO on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Each of about 520 facilities has its region, district, name, type (such as hospital or health centre) and latitude and longitude, with humanitarian exchange (HXL) tags on the columns. Coverage is national, with a reference period from October 2022 to October 2023. The table and a shapefile are free and available to download under CC BY-IGO. Caveats: some facilities have no coordinates, capacity, ownership and functionality are not given, and the list has not been updated since 2023. Simulation uses: mapping health facilities against flood and drought displacement areas, planning outbreak and emergency response logistics, and modelling access to care for displaced populations. Related records: the sub-Saharan Africa public health facilities database (data-ssa-public-health-facilities) and Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) give comparable facility points for the region.
